pinnedOracle.samePiCalibration: All eight cases returned identical parsed entries and file-mutation observations on two independent runs.

pisharp.interchangeClassResult: 50/50 passed in the final PiJsonlSessionInterchangeTests class.

semanticOutcomes.emptyAndBlankFiles: The public Import API rejects an uninitialized file; pinned loadEntriesFromFile returns an empty entry list.
semanticOutcomes.headerWithoutCwd: Accepted when an invocation CWD fallback is supplied.
semanticOutcomes.malformedPrefixBeforeHeader: Malformed JSON is skipped and the valid header is accepted.
semanticOutcomes.crlfBlankMalformedAndFinalValidRecord: Valid session and message are retained.
semanticOutcomes.truncatedFinalFragment: Valid preceding records survive; malformed tail is ignored.
semanticOutcomes.oversizedRecordWithValidDescendant: Pinned Pi retains both the 16 MiB+1 record and its descendant. PiSharp skips the oversized row under its 16 MiB per-entry bound and still imports the following valid descendant.
semanticOutcomes.maximumSizedRecord: PiSharp accepts a record whose UTF-8 size is exactly 16 MiB.

acceptedDifferences.pinnedPi: loadEntriesFromFile appends a newline after an unterminated final valid or malformed record once a valid header is established.
acceptedDifferences.piSharp: PiSharp's string importer leaves the input untouched; file-store tests preserve source bytes and use guarded atomic writes.

acceptedDifferences.pinnedPi: The pinned line loader has no equivalent 128 MiB file or 16 MiB individual-record cap.
acceptedDifferences.piSharp: Import rejects files over 128 MiB and skips records over 16 MiB.

acceptedDifferences.pinnedPi: findMostRecentSession scans at most 1 MiB for a usable header; a valid 1,048,769-byte header is visible to streaming list but skipped by recent lookup.
acceptedDifferences.piSharp: PiSharp parses the complete file within its 16 MiB record and 128 MiB file limits, so the same candidate remains available to recent lookup.

acceptedDifferences.pinnedPi: Recent-session discovery skips candidates that fail to load.
acceptedDifferences.piSharp: Recent-session discovery also skips invalid candidates, while explicit catalog listing reports the failing path so corruption is visible.

acceptedDifferences.pinnedPi: The pinned loader accepts future version 4 and string version "3" through JavaScript comparison/coercion.
acceptedDifferences.piSharp: PiSharp rejects unsupported versions and noninteger version fields in direct imports and file-backed list/load/recent operations.
